fields.help_en:
The tag that identifies the language of the RTMP input. It can be referenced by the output. The maximum length is 32 characters. Supported characters:

Unicode letters

Digits (0-9)

Underscore (_)

Hyphen (-)

Space (a space cannot be at the beginning or end)
fields.help_zh:
语言名称，仅rtmp类型输入有效，表示output使用的Name标签。
该字段长度限制为英文32字符，支持以下字符类型：
Unicode各国语言的字母：包括拉丁字母（如英语、法语）、中文、阿拉伯字母以及其他语言的字母。
数字：允许使用0-9的数字字符。 
英文下划线 (_) 
英文中划线 (-)
空格，空格可以出现在字段中间，不能出现在首尾

fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The referenced AudioSettings
fields.help_zh: 引用的音频设置名称列表

fields.help_en: The manifest audio group ID. To associate several audio tracks into one group, assign the same audio group ID. Viewers can select a track as needed. Letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_) are supported. It can be up to 40 characters in length
fields.help_zh:
manifest音频组id设置。通过指定 AudioGroupId，可以将多个音频轨道归为同一组，以便于在播放时选择音轨。
支持英文+数字+英文短划线(-)、下划线(_)。长度限制英文40字符
fields.name: audio_group_id

fields.help_en: The manifest name modifier. The child manifests include this modifier in their M3U8 file names. Letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_) are supported. The maximum length is 40 characters
fields.help_zh:
manifest后缀，一般用于子m3u8命名。
支持英文+数字+英文短划线(-)、下划线(_)。长度限制英文40字符
fields.name: name_modifier

fields.help_zh: 输出组类型为MediaPackage时的输出设置

fields.help_en:
The media type of the output. Valid values:

0: Audio and Video.

1: Audio. If you set the value to 1, you cannot reference VideoSettings.

2: Video. If you set the value to 2, you cannot reference AudioSettings
fields.help_zh:
输出的媒体类型，枚举。可选值：
0：音视频。
1：纯音频。设置为纯音频时，不允许引用视频设置。
2：纯视频。设置为纯视频时，不允许引用音频设置
fields.name: media_type

fields.help_zh:
输出名称。

fields.help_zh: 输出列表设置

输出组类型。
目前支持 MediaPackage

fields.help_zh:
音频编码类型。若填空则copy，即随源。
可选值：aac，libfdk_aac
fields.name: audio_codec

fields.help_en: The audio bitrate. Unit: bit/s. Valid values: 8000 to 1000000. The value must be divisible by 1000
fields.help_zh: 音频比特率，单位bps。范围: [8000, 1000000]，需要能被1000整除
fields.name: bitrate

fields.help_en: The audio codec profile. When AudioCodec is set to aac, AAC-LOW and AAC-MAIN are supported. When AudioCodec is set to libfdk_aac, AAC-LOW, AAC-HE, and AAC-HEV2 are supported
fields.help_zh:
音频编码级别。
当codec="aac"时，支持"AAC-LOW"，"AAC-MAIN"。
当codec="libfdk_aac"时，支持："AAC-LOW"，"AAC-HE"，"AAC-HEV2"
fields.name: profile

fields.help_en: The audio sample rate. Unit: Hz. Valid values: 22050, 32000, 44100, 48000, and 96000

fields.help_en: The audio encoding settings
fields.help_zh: 音频编码设置

fields.help_zh: 音频选择器名称
fields.name: audio_selector_name

If the selected audio track does not have a language code, or if the audio selector cannot find a track that matches its criteria, this language code is used
fields.help_zh:
ISO639-2语言代码，3字符。
当selector选择的音轨对应输出有语言代码，优先使用selector的语言代码；若选择器选择的音轨没有语言代码或者没有和选择器匹配的音轨，则使用该语言代码

Unicode letters

fields.help_zh:
语言名称，仅rtmp类型输入有效，表示output使用的Name标签。

fields.help_en: The name of the audio settings. Letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_) are supported. It can be up to 64 characters in length
fields.help_zh:
音频设置名称。
支持英文+数字+英文短划线(-)、下划线(_)。长度限制英文64字符
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The height of the output. If you set it to 0 or leave it empty, the height automatically adapts to the specified width to maintain the original aspect ratio.

Valid values:

For regular transcoding, the larger dimension cannot exceed 3840 px, and the smaller one cannot exceed 2160 px.

For Narrowband HD™ transcoding, the larger dimension cannot exceed 1920 px, and the smaller one cannot exceed 1080 px
fields.help_zh:
视频分辨率高，不设置或者设置为0则按Width自适应缩放。

取值范围：
对于普通转码，需要满足max(Width, Height) < 3840，min(Width, Height) < 2160
对于窄带高清转码，需要满足max(Width, Height) < 1920，min(Width, Height) < 1080
fields.name: height

fields.help_en: The name of the video settings. Letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_) are supported. It can be up to 64 characters in length
fields.help_zh:
视频设置名称。
支持英文+数字+英文短划线(-)、下划线(_)。长度限制英文64字符
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The video codec. Valid values: H264 and H265
fields.help_zh:
视频编码类型。
可选值：H264，H265
fields.name: video_codec

fields.help_en: The video encoding level. It is not supported yet
fields.help_zh: 视频编码级别。暂不支持
fields.name: level

fields.help_en: The H.264 profile. Valid values: BASELINE, HIGH, and MAIN. Default value: MAIN. The parameter takes effect only when the codec is H.264
fields.help_zh: H264编码质量等级。BASELINE、HIGH、MAIN。默认为MAIN。仅H264编码器设置生效
fields.name: profile

fields.help_en: The video encoding settings
fields.help_zh: 视频编码详情设置
fields.name: codec_detail

fields.help_en: The frame rate mode. Valid values: SPECIFIED (fixed frame rate) and FROM_SOURCE (use source specification)
fields.help_zh:
视频帧率设置模式。
可选值：SPECIFIED（固定帧率），FROM_SOURCE（帧率随源）
fields.name: framerate_control

fields.help_en: The denominator of the fixed frame rate. The parameter is required when FramerateControl is set to SPECIFIED. Valid values: 1 to 60. The numerator must be divisible by the denominator
fields.help_zh: 固定帧率的帧率分母，当视频帧率设置模式为SPECIFIED时必传。范围: [1,60]，需要能被分子整除
fields.name: framerate_denominator

fields.help_en: The numerator of the fixed frame rate. The parameter is required when FramerateControl is set to SPECIFIED. Valid values: 1 to 60. The numerator must be divisible by the denominator
fields.help_zh: 固定帧率的帧率分子，当视频帧率设置模式为SPECIFIED时必传。范围: [1,60]，需要能整除分母
fields.name: framerate_numerator

fields.help_en: The frame rate. If it is not specified, the source specification is used
fields.help_zh: 视频帧率设置，不设置则随源
fields.name: framerate

fields.help_en: The number of B frames. Valid values: 1 to 3
fields.help_zh: B帧数。范围: [1, 3]
fields.name: bframes_num

fields.help_en: The GOP size. When GopSizeUnits is set to SECONDS, the value range is from 1 to 20. When GopSizeUnits is set to FRAMES, the value range is from 1 to 3000
fields.help_zh:
视频GOP大小。
当长度单位为SECONDS时，取值范围为[1, 20]。当长度单位为FRAMES时，取值范围为[1, 3000]
fields.name: gop_size

fields.help_en: The GOP size unit. Valid values: FRAMES and SECONDS
fields.help_zh:
视频GOP长度单位。
可选值：FRAMES（单位帧），SECONDS（单位秒）
fields.name: gop_size_units

fields.help_en: The GOP setting. If it is not specified, the source specification is used
fields.help_zh: 视频GOP设置，不设置则随源
fields.name: gop

fields.help_en: The video bitrate. Unit: bit/s. If you set it to 0 or leave it empty, the source specification is used. Valid values: 50000 to 6000000. The value must be divisible by 1000
fields.help_zh: 视频比特率，单位bps。不填或0则随源。范围:[50000,6000000]，需要能被1000整除
fields.name: bitrate

fields.help_en: The video buffer size. Unit: bit/s. Valid values: 100000 to 6000000. The value must be divisible by 1000
fields.help_zh: 视频编码缓冲区大小，单位bps。范围: [100000, 6000000]，需要能被1000整除
fields.name: buffer_size

fields.help_en: The maximum bitrate. Unit: bit/s. Valid values: 100000 to 6000000. The value must be divisible by 1000
fields.help_zh: 视频编码最大比特率，单位bps。范围: [100000, 6000000]，需要能被1000整除
fields.name: max_bitrate

fields.help_en: The bitrate control mode. Valid values: CBR, ABR, and VBR
fields.help_zh:
视频编码码控规则。
可选值：CBR、ABR和VBR
fields.name: rate_control_mode

fields.help_en: The video encoding rate. If it is not specified, the source specification is used
fields.help_zh: 视频编码速率设置，不设置则随源
fields.name: rate

fields.help_en: The video encoding settings
fields.help_zh: 视频编码设置
fields.name: video_codec_setting

fields.help_en:
The video transcoding method. Valid values:

NORMAL: regular transcoding

NBHD: Narrowband HD™ transcoding

If not specified, regular transcoding is used by default
fields.help_zh:
视频转码方式，枚举。可选值：

NORMAL：普通转码。
NBHD：窄带高清转码。

不配置时默认为普通转码
fields.name: video_codec_type

fields.help_en:
The width of the output. If you set it to 0 or leave it empty, the width automatically adapts to the specified height to maintain the original aspect ratio.

Valid values:

For regular transcoding, the larger dimension cannot exceed 3840 px, and the smaller one cannot exceed 2160 px.

For Narrowband HD™ transcoding, the larger dimension cannot exceed 1920 px, and the smaller one cannot exceed 1080 px
fields.help_zh:
视频分辨率宽，不设置或者设置为0则按Height自适应缩放。

取值范围：
对于普通转码，需要满足max(Width, Height) < 3840，min(Width, Height) < 2160
对于窄带高清转码，需要满足max(Width, Height) < 1920，min(Width, Height) < 1080
fields.name: width
